capabilities: capture memos from a hotkey, ribbon button, or command into dated journal files
auto-tag entries with configured keywords and filter them via quick tag buttons
track tasks with TODO/DOING/DONE states, checkboxes, and time tracking
run Pomodoro sessions tied to tasks with focus/break rotation and stats
refresh the view when journal files are changed by external tools
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README; installable from the community plugin store (search 'fengshuzi'); Pomodoro data is stored in data.json rather than Markdown files.
motivation: The author built it because inspiration is fleeting and a zero-friction capture entry is more useful than a complex note system.
problem: Jotting a fleeting thought in Obsidian means opening or finding a note first; there is no low-friction entry for one-line timestamped memos.

relations.evidence: Flomo — 卡片式 UI 和轻量记录理念

summary: Quick-capture plugin that saves timestamped memos, tags, and tasks as Markdown list items in daily journal files, with task tracking and Pomodoro support.
